zh.title: 波音737 MAX 10取得FAA認證　最大型號補齊MAX家族陣容
zh.summary: 737 MAX 10於10月20日取得FAA認證，與8月獲證的MAX 7補齊家族陣容。該機最高可載230人，搭載LEAP-1B發動機及鋸齒狀降噪設計，為737發展寫下新里程碑。
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）於10月20日核發波音737 MAX 10修訂型別檢定證，並授權生產，為交付航空公司鋪路。繼最短的MAX 7於今年8月獲證後，最長的MAX 10也通過審查，現有MAX家族四款主要型號的認證至此完成。
MAX 10全長43.8公尺，是737 MAX家族機身最長、載客量最高的機型，典型雙艙等配置為185至210席，最高230席，航程可達5,740公里，主要服務高運量的短中程航線。
動力採用CFM International新世代LEAP系列的LEAP-1B發動機，為737 MAX專用型號。發動機艙尾緣的鋸齒狀噴嘴（chevron nozzles），與787採用相同類型的降噪概念，透過改善排氣與周圍氣流混合，降低機場周邊噪音；兩款客機使用的發動機並不相同。
認證歷經多年延宕，測試涵蓋發動機防冰改良及強化迎角系統。波音表示，飛行測試累計976架次、逾2,060小時。FAA核准的是設計符合安全要求，並不代表所有航機已完成交付或投入載客。
MAX 10是現有MAX家族最後完成認證的主要衍生型，象徵737產品線的重要里程碑。臺灣國籍航空目前尚未公開宣布訂購737 MAX，但這款機型的後續交付，仍將影響區域航空公司的運能布局，也為延續數十年的737發展史寫下新一頁。

en.title: Boeing 737 MAX 10 Wins FAA Certification, Completing Main MAX Lineup
en.summary: FAA certification of the 737 MAX 10 on October 20 follows the MAX 7's August approval. The largest variant seats up to 230 passengers and features LEAP-1B engines and chevron noise-reduction technology.
body: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) issued an amended type certificate for the Boeing 737 MAX 10 and authorized production on October 20, clearing the way for deliveries. Following the shortest variant, the MAX 7, gaining approval in August, the longest MAX 10 completes certification of the four main MAX variants.

At 43.8 metres long, the MAX 10 has the longest fuselage and highest passenger capacity in the MAX family. It typically seats 185–210 passengers in two classes, with a maximum of 230, and has a range of up to 5,740 kilometres, serving high-demand short- and medium-haul routes.

It uses the LEAP-1B, the 737 MAX-specific member of CFM International's new-generation LEAP engine family. Chevron nozzles at the rear of the nacelles use the same type of noise-reduction concept as the 787, improving the mixing of exhaust and surrounding airflow to reduce airport-community noise. The aircraft do not use the same engines.

Certification was delayed for years. Testing covered engine anti-ice improvements and the enhanced angle-of-attack system. Boeing reported 976 flight tests totalling more than 2,060 hours. FAA approval confirms compliance of the design with safety requirements; it does not mean every aircraft has been delivered or entered passenger service.

The MAX 10 is the last major variant of the existing MAX family to complete certification, marking a milestone for the 737 product line. Taiwanese airlines have not publicly announced 737 MAX orders, but future deliveries will still influence regional airlines' capacity plans and add another chapter to the 737's decades-long history.

zh.title: WestJet售出27架波音737-700 仍將續飛其中17架
zh.summary: WestJet出售27架波音737-700，仍將續飛其中17架
body: Simple Flying於2026年10月20日報導，WestJet已出售27架波音737-700。報導標題指出，WestJet仍將讓其中17架繼續飛行，並提及MAX 10時程延後。標題同時列出出售數量與續飛數量，並明確表示17架是這27架飛機的一部分。
Simple Flying的摘要將這項機隊調整描述為WestJet下一波老舊737 NG退役。摘要以「下一波」概括退役安排；標題則列出出售27架、其中17架仍將續飛的具體數量。

en.title: WestJet Sold 27 Boeing 737-700s, Will Keep 17 Flying
en.summary: WestJet sold 27 Boeing 737-700s and will keep 17 flying.
body: Simple Flying reported on October 20, 2026, that WestJet had sold 27 Boeing 737-700s. Its headline says the airline will keep 17 of those aircraft flying and also mentions a slip affecting the MAX 10. The headline presents both the sale count and the continued-flying count, describing the 17 aircraft as part of the 27.

Simple Flying's summary characterizes the fleet change as the next wave of retirements for WestJet's aging 737 NGs. The summary uses that phrase for the retirement activity, while the headline specifies that 27 aircraft were sold and 17 of them will continue flying.

zh.title: SyberJet展示SJ36全尺寸模型並介紹單人操作航電系統
zh.summary: SyberJet展示SJ36全尺寸模型，介紹單人操作航電並開放預約
body: SyberJet Aircraft於2026年10月19日在拉斯維加斯附近的Henderson Executive Airport（HSH）展示SJ36輕型商務噴射機全尺寸模型，並開放該機預約。公司也介紹為單人操作設計的自製航電系統。
SyberJet表示，名為SyberVision的航電系統仍在研發中，功能可能在認證期間調整。SJ36駕駛艙規劃採用六具高解析度觸控螢幕，並整合飛行管理系統、自動駕駛及自動油門。公司以2032年取得FAA認證並開始首批客戶交付為目標。

en.title: SyberJet unveils SJ36 mockup and single-pilot avionics at NBAA-BACE
en.summary: SyberJet unveiled an SJ36 mockup, presented single-pilot avionics and opened reservations.
body: SyberJet Aircraft unveiled a full-scale mockup of its SJ36 light business jet at Henderson Executive Airport (HSH) near Las Vegas on October 19, 2026, and opened reservations for the aircraft. The company also presented an in-house avionics system designed for single-pilot operations.

SyberJet says its SyberVision avionics system remains in research and development, and its features could change during certification. The planned SJ36 flight deck includes six high-definition touchscreens, an integrated flight management system, autopilot and autothrottle. SyberJet is targeting FAA certification and first customer deliveries in 2032.

zh.title: 美國海軍從航母遠端控制MQ-25A無人機，相隔逾2,100英里
zh.summary: 美國海軍從航母遠端控制MQ-25A無人機，兩地相隔逾2,100英里
body: 美國海軍表示，已從在太平洋航行的航母遠端控制波音MQ-25A Stingray無人機；航母與位於伊利諾州的飛機相隔逾2,100英里。海軍於10月19日宣佈這項里程碑，稱這是航母在海上航行時首次與MQ-25A建立此類控制連線。
這項初步海上測試在尼米茲級航母「雷根號」（USS Ronald Reagan，CVN 76）上進行，艦上無人航空作戰中心與位於伊利諾州Mascoutah的波音設施內飛機建立衛星連線。連線使用航母的MD-5C地面控制站及低地球軌道衛星網路，使艦上人員能在超出一般視線範圍的距離與無人機通訊並進行控制。此次測試未進行空中加油。

en.title: US Navy remotely controls MQ-25A Stingray from carrier over 2,100 miles away
en.summary: The US Navy remotely controlled an MQ-25A from a carrier over 2,100 miles away.
body: The US Navy said on 19 October that it had remotely controlled a Boeing MQ-25A Stingray from an aircraft carrier sailing in the Pacific. The carrier was more than 2,100 miles from the aircraft in Illinois. The Navy described the connection as the first of its kind between an MQ-25A and a carrier underway at sea.

The preliminary sea trial took place aboard the Nimitz-class USS Ronald Reagan. Personnel at the ship’s Unmanned Air Warfare Center established a satellite connection with the aircraft at Boeing’s facility in Mascoutah, Illinois. The connection used the carrier’s MD-5C Ground Control Station and a low Earth orbit satellite network, enabling communication and control beyond normal line-of-sight range. The trial did not include an aerial refuelling demonstration.

zh.title: Bristow選定挪威五處場址 規劃2027年混合電動飛機示範
zh.summary: Bristow等選定挪威五處場址，混合電動飛機示範預計2027年第三季首飛
body: Bristow Group、Electra、Avinor及Civil Aviation Authority of Norway（CAA Norway）已選定挪威五處場址，規劃於2027年進行混合電動飛機示範。首趟示範飛行預計於2027年第三季進行。計畫將使用Electra的EL2技術示範機，評估混合電動飛機在不同航空環境中的運作方式，包括既有國際機場、短跑道設施及沒有傳統跑道的地點。
Horvnes Quay（靠近Sandnessjøen）與Kongsbergporten Business Park將用於評估沒有既有跑道的新型起降場址。Trondheim and Oslo airports將用於評估飛機融入大型機場環境及既有空中交通系統的方式；Mosjøen Airport則作為短跑道機場範例，供合作夥伴檢視飛機能力並評估新的進場程序。

en.title: Bristow selects five Norwegian sites for 2027 aircraft demonstrations
en.summary: Bristow and partners select five Norwegian sites; first hybrid-electric demonstration flight planned for Q3 2027.
body: Bristow Group, Electra, Avinor and the Civil Aviation Authority of Norway (CAA Norway) have selected five locations in Norway for hybrid-electric aircraft demonstrations planned for 2027. The first demonstration flight is planned for the third quarter of 2027. The programme will use Electra’s EL2 technology demonstrator to explore operations across established international airports, short-runway facilities and locations without conventional runways.

Horvnes Quay near Sandnessjøen and Kongsbergporten Business Park will be used to investigate operations at sites without established runways. Trondheim and Oslo airports will allow the partners to assess integration into larger airport environments and existing air traffic systems. Mosjøen Airport will serve as a short-runway example for examining the aircraft’s capabilities and assessing new approach procedures.

zh.title: 首架量產Cessna Citation CJ4 Gen3商務機下線
zh.summary: Cessna首架量產Citation CJ4 Gen3下線，測試累計近1,100小時
body: Cessna工作人員近日在美國Wichita廠區聚集，首架量產Citation CJ4 Gen3商務噴射機於該處下線。Textron Aviation於2026年10月20日確認這項進展，並稱下線是該機型朝投入服務推進的重要里程碑。
CJ4 Gen3計畫在兩架測試機上累計近1,100小時飛行測試，近期活動包括高溫環境及電氣系統認證測試。報導指出，公司原先希望該機型於2026年投入服務，後來已將預期時程修訂為2027年。

en.title: First production Cessna Citation CJ4 Gen3 executive jet rolls out in Wichita
en.summary: Cessna rolls out its first production Citation CJ4 Gen3 as flight testing nears 1,100 hours.
body: Cessna staff members recently gathered at the Wichita facility in the United States as the first production Citation CJ4 Gen3 executive jet was rolled out. Textron Aviation confirmed on October 20, 2026, that the rollout marked an important milestone as the aircraft advances toward entry into service.

The CJ4 Gen3 program has logged nearly 1,100 flight-test hours across two test articles. Recent activities include hot-weather and electrical-system certification testing. The report says the company had hoped the Cessna Citation CJ4 Gen3 would enter service in 2026, but the timing has since been revised to 2027.
